phaseNumbering: Phases 1-2 were each scoped and delivered as a single journey step from docs/MASTER-PLAN.md §4 (1=Enquiry/Intent, 2=Extract Dates & Location), not the original 10-phase infra grouping below. Phase 3 is scoped the same way (Determine Vehicle = journey Step 3). Phase ids 4-10 below are the original, pre-journey-step-granularity plan, kept for reference — their scope/ids will be reconciled with the real journey-step sequence (Steps 4-19) as work reaches them, same as phases 1-2 already turned out to differ from this document's original phase 1-2 grouping.

no fake success paths (NOT_CONFIGURED used for missing providers)

phases.name: Foundation & Platform Skeleton + Enquiry / Intent Recognition
phases.goal: Runnable, tested, CI-gated monorepo (api, worker, web, db, cache, observability, security, design tokens) delivering business Step 1 end to end: customer message -> deterministic AI intent recognition -> persisted + audited -> queued for background processing.
deliverables: pnpm workspaces (no Turborepo — plain tsc per package, pnpm -r respects the dependency graph) + ESLint flat config + Prettier + Vitest + Playwright + .env.example + .nvmrc

apps/api: Fastify 5 + Zod type provider, OpenAPI /docs, /health + /live + /ready, request-id/correlation (AsyncLocalStorage), pino logs, OTel bootstrap (NOT_CONFIGURED by default), env->Zod config, AppError envelope, graceful shutdown, helmet/CORS/rate-limit, POST /v1/enquiries + GET /v1/enquiries/:id
apps/worker: BullMQ worker consuming post-enquiry-processing, idempotent processor + audit event
apps/web: Next.js App Router + Tailwind + original Emerald&Copper components (Monogram/GlassCard/CopperCard/PillButton/StatusChip) + enquiry form + server-side SSRF-safe proxy route

packages/config, packages/domain, packages/ai (RuleBasedIntentEngine + prompt-injection sanitizer), packages/security, packages/observability, packages/contracts, packages/db (Prisma: Tenant/Conversation/Message/IntentRecord/AuditEvent/IdempotencyKey + migration), packages/testing (real-Postgres/Redis test helpers)
docker-compose.yml: postgres, redis (minio/otel-collector/grafana deferred — not needed until a real object-storage or exporter consumer exists)
.github/workflows/ci.yml (full gate pipeline) + security.yml (pnpm audit, gitleaks, semgrep)
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/phases/PHASE-01.md
acceptance: pnpm install && docker compose up -d && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm dev:api / dev:worker / dev:web starts each service
GET /health -> 200 with observability status; GET /docs serves OpenAPI
web enquiry form renders with the design tokens and round-trips a real request through the API
POST /v1/enquiries recognizes intent, persists conversation+message+intent+audit atomically, enqueues background processing; GET /v1/enquiries/:id returns it
all gates pass: typecheck, lint, format, 91 unit + 21 integration + 21 security + 4 e2e (incl. accessibility) tests, production build — see docs/phases/PHASE-01.md §8

phases.name: Extract Dates & Location (journey Step 2)
phases.goal: Take a Phase 1 conversation's validated, intent-recognized message and propose+verify pickup/return dates and pickup/dropoff locations. AI proposes (DateExtractionService, LocationExtractionService); deterministic domain logic verifies (TemporalValidationService) before anything is persisted or returned.
deliverables: packages/domain: LocationType, AmbiguityCode, ValidationErrorCode, normalizedLocationSchema, dateLocationExtractionResultSchema

packages/ai/step2: DateExtractionService (named-month/range/ISO/numeric/relative/next-weekday dates, ambiguity-safe, DST-aware via Intl), LocationExtractionService (Dubai/UAE gazetteer via a LocationProvider abstraction), TemporalValidationService (PAST_DATE/RETURN_BEFORE_OR_EQUAL_PICKUP/IMPOSSIBLE_DATE/TIMEZONE_MISMATCH/UNSUPPORTED_LOCATION + confidence), DateLocationExtractionOrchestrator
packages/security/resilience.ts: withTimeout, CircuitBreaker, RateLimiter, applied to the location provider seam
packages/db: DateLocationExtraction model + migration, dateLocationExtractionRepository, findLatestMessageForConversation
packages/contracts: extractDatesLocationParamsSchema / extractDatesLocationResponseSchema
apps/api: POST /v1/enquiries/:conversationId/dates-location (dateLocationService.ts + routes/v1/temporal.ts)
docs/PHASE-2.md
acceptance: every required test case passes: 15 Oct; 15-19 Oct; tomorrow; next Friday; ambiguous 10/11/26 (never guessed); invalid date; past date; return before pickup; timezone mismatch; Dubai; unknown location; malicious prompt injection
full Phase 1 regression re-run and green (no working Phase 1 functionality broken)
all gates pass: typecheck, lint, format, 180 unit + 32 integration + 29 security tests, 4 e2e, production build — see docs/PHASE-2.md §8

phases.name: Determine Vehicle (journey Step 3)
phases.goal: Map the customer's vehicle preference (plus Step 2's dates/location) to a fleet class/model proposal, deterministically verified against real fleet data — same AI-proposes/domain-verifies split as Steps 1-2. Full scope to be given when this phase is started (see docs/PHASE-2.md §13 for the forward contract as currently understood).

phases.name: Security Engine & Zero Trust
phases.goal: Zero-trust layering verified by tests (WAF -> AuthN -> AuthZ -> Tenant -> Sandbox -> Egress -> DB policy -> Encrypted data).
deliverables: Edge: Redis rate limiting + WAF rules (body size, schema, IP lists, bot signals)
AuthN: OIDC/OAuth2, <=15-min access tokens, rotating refresh, step-up/MFA for admin
AuthZ: RBAC + ABAC policy engine (tenant, ownership, journey state, tier) in one middleware and in services
Tenant isolation: RLS on every table, per-connection tenant context, cross-tenant negative tests
AI sandbox: tool permission matrix, egress allowlist, injection defences, output DLP
Data: TLS, field-level PII encryption, secrets management, key rotation runbook
Detection & response: anomaly rules, automatic restricted response, security event stream, T4 escalation
CI: Semgrep, dependency scan, gitleaks, Trivy image scan, ZAP baseline
docs/SECURITY-MODEL.md (STRIDE) + compromised-account kill-chain test
acceptance: kill-chain test proves each layer contains a compromised account
authz matrix tests
all scanners green with zero critical
